name: dafyomi-berakhot-1
approved: Drafted overnight Nov 5–6 2026 by Claude from a line-by-line check against the Gemara and Rashi on Sefaria (each finding re-checked before applying); David asked for fixes to go live overnight. Awaiting review by a rav.

repairs.find: could mean the sun's light starts to fade, and "וטהר" could mean the man becomes pure.
repairs.replace: could mean the sun's light starts to fade (so תוספות; רש"י reads it as the sun's light rising the next morning, the eighth day), and "וטהר" could mean the man becomes pure (רש"י: by bringing his קרבנות).
repairs.why: The site gives only Tosafos' reading (start of sunset) as if it were the plain meaning; Rashi reads ביאת אורו as the sun's light rising on the eighth morning, with the man becoming pure by bringing his קרבנות, and the site does not say it is following another view.
repairs.source: Berakhot 2b ("דילמא ביאת אורו הוא ומאי וטהר טהר גברא"); Rashi s.v. דילמא ביאת אורו: "שיאור השמש ביום השמיני ויטהר האיש עצמו בהבאת קרבנותיו"; Tosafos s.v. דילמא ביאת אורו quotes Rashi and offers the start-of-sunset reading

repairs.find: That would also move the start time of evening קריאת שמע earlier.
repairs.replace: That would also move the start time of evening קריאת שמע earlier. (This follows תוספות. רש"י explains the challenge differently: 'ביאת אורו' is the sun's light rising the next morning, the eighth day, and 'וטהר' means the man becomes pure by bringing his קרבנות, so he could not eat תרומה until then.)
repairs.why: The site gives only Tosafos' reading (start of sunset) as if it were the plain meaning; Rashi reads ביאת אורו as the sun's light rising on the eighth morning, with the man becoming pure by bringing his קרבנות, and the site does not say it is following another view.
repairs.source: Berakhot 2b ("דילמא ביאת אורו הוא ומאי וטהר טהר גברא"); Rashi s.v. דילמא ביאת אורו: "שיאור השמש ביום השמיני ויטהר האיש עצמו בהבאת קרבנותיו"; Tosafos s.v. דילמא ביאת אורו quotes Rashi and offers the start-of-sunset reading

repairs.find: He means the very start of sunset, when the sun's light begins to go, not full nightfall.
repairs.replace: So תוספות: the very start of sunset, when the sun's light begins to go, not full nightfall. רש"י reads it as the sun's light rising the next morning, the eighth day, when the man brings his קרבנות and only then eats.
repairs.why: The site gives only Tosafos' reading (start of sunset) as if it were the plain meaning; Rashi reads ביאת אורו as the sun's light rising on the eighth morning, with the man becoming pure by bringing his קרבנות, and the site does not say it is following another view.
repairs.source: Berakhot 2b ("דילמא ביאת אורו הוא ומאי וטהר טהר גברא"); Rashi s.v. דילמא ביאת אורו: "שיאור השמש ביום השמיני ויטהר האיש עצמו בהבאת קרבנותיו"; Tosafos s.v. דילמא ביאת אורו quotes Rashi and offers the start-of-sunset reading

repairs.find: or perhaps it is the setting of its light,
repairs.replace: or perhaps it is the setting of its light (so תוספות; רש"י: the rising of its light the next morning),
repairs.why: The site gives only Tosafos' reading (start of sunset) as if it were the plain meaning; Rashi reads ביאת אורו as the sun's light rising on the eighth morning, with the man becoming pure by bringing his קרבנות, and the site does not say it is following another view.

repairs.find: The final picture: poor man = כהן eating תרומה (stars coming out).
repairs.replace: The picture at this stage (overturned in steps 16-21): poor man = כהן eating תרומה (stars coming out).
repairs.why: Step 15's answer is not final: steps 16-21 overturn it and conclude the poor man's time is separate from and later than the כהן's, so calling it 'the final picture' contradicts the amud's own conclusion.
repairs.source: Berakhot 2b: "אלא לאו שמע מינה שיעורא דעני לחוד ושיעורא דכהן לחוד שמע מינה ... דעני מאוחר"

repairs.find: A pit can't fill up just from the rain that drops straight into its mouth. Water has to be brought in from outside.
repairs.replace: Rashi: if you dig earth out of a pit and throw it back in, the pit does not fill up. So too, the nation cannot feed its poor from its own resources; food must come from outside. (Other explanations: its own spring water, or rain falling into its mouth, is not enough.)
repairs.why: The note gives only the Geonim's explanation (rain into its mouth) without saying so; Rashi explains חוליתו as the earth dug out of the pit itself.
repairs.source: Berakhot 3b "ואין הבור מתמלא מחוליתו"; Rashi s.v. אין הבור מתמלא מחוליתו: "העוקר חוליא מבור כרוי וחוזר ומשליכו לתוכו אין מתמלא בכך"; Tosafos ibid. (Rabbeinu Tam: מנביעתו)

repairs.find: praying close to bedtime
repairs.replace: praying right after getting out of bed (רש״י's reading of 'close to my bed')
repairs.why: The overview says אבא בנימין prayed close to bedtime, but step 30 (following רש״י) explains 'סמוך למטתי' as davening right after rising, before any work or learning; the overview contradicts the step and רש״י.
repairs.source: Berakhot 5b ״אֶלָּא אֵימָא סָמוּךְ לְמִטָּתִי״; Rashi s.v. סמוך למטתי: ״שלא לעשות מלאכה ושלא לעסוק בתורה כשעמדתי ממטתי עד שאקרא ק"ש ואתפלל״

repairs.find: רב הונא calls one who prays behind the בית הכנסת facing away a רשע
repairs.replace: רב הונא calls one who prays behind the בית הכנסת a רשע, and אביי limits this to one who faces away from it
repairs.why: The overview puts אביי's limit (only when facing away) into רב הונא's mouth; רב הונא's statement has no such condition, and the step-by-step content correctly credits the limit to אביי.
repairs.source: Berakhot 6b: אמר רב הונא כל המתפלל אחורי בית הכנסת נקרא רשע ... אמר אביי לא אמרן אלא דלא מהדר אפיה לבי כנישתא

repairs.find: How can the ברייתא call the time after עמוד השחר 'night' and also say that reading then counts for the daytime שמע?
repairs.replace: How can the second ברייתא say both readings are 'in the day', which makes the time before sunrise day, and also count the reading then as the nighttime שמע?
repairs.why: The question being answered here (the sunrise ברייתא, end of 8b) is the reverse: the ברייתא calls the time 'day' yet counts the reading as the NIGHT שמע; the site describes the first ברייתא's question instead.
repairs.source: Berakhot 8b-9a: אמרת שתי פעמים ביום, אלמא קודם הנץ החמה יממא הוא... אלמא ליליא הוא; Rashi 9a s.v. והאי דקרו ליה ליליא – דקאמר יוצא בו ק"ש של לילה

repairs.find: legally, after עמוד השחר it is truly day, so in the ברייתא the reading then counts as the daytime שמע. It is called 'night' only
repairs.replace: legally, the time before sunrise (after עמוד השחר) is truly day, which is why the ברייתא says both readings are 'in the day'. The reading then is still called the 'night' reading only
repairs.why: In this ברייתא the reading before sunrise counts as the NIGHT שמע (the one after sunrise is the day reading); the site says it counts as the daytime שמע, which contradicts the next sentence and Rashi.
repairs.source: Berakhot 8b: אחת קודם הנץ החמה ואחת לאחר הנץ החמה... אחת של יום ואחת של לילה; Rashi 9a s.v. והאי דקרו ליה ליליא – דקאמר יוצא בו ק"ש של לילה; s.v. משום דאיכא דגנו – וקרינא ביה ובשכבך

repairs.find: The ברייתא calls the time after dawn 'night,' yet treats a reading then as the daytime שמע, which seems contradictory.
repairs.replace: The ברייתא calls the time before sunrise 'day' (both readings are 'in the day'), yet treats a reading then as the nighttime שמע, which seems contradictory.
repairs.why: Same reversal as in whatsHappening; the sunrise ברייתא's difficulty is day-wording vs. a night reading.
repairs.source: Berakhot 8b: אלמא קודם הנץ החמה יממא הוא... אלמא ליליא הוא

repairs.find: He means: I grow it only to oppose people who shave. A compliment turned into a jab.
repairs.replace: So the רשב״א: I grow it only to oppose people who shave. Rashi reads it differently: since you praised it, I will hand it over to the destroyers, the razor and scissors. So too, when רבי אלעזר leaned, as if praising רבי ישמעאל's way, רבי ישמעאל changed.
repairs.why: The site gives the Rashba's reading of the parable as the plain meaning without attribution; Rashi reads it the opposite way (the man will cut off the praised beard). (The note sits in the phrase's notes field, shown in brackets after the English.)
repairs.source: Berakhot 11a (יִהְיֶה כְּנֶגֶד הַמַּשְׁחִיתִים); Rashi s.v. לאחד שאמרו לו זקנך מגודל: הגדול הזה יהיה נתון לתער ולמספרים שאביא עליו ואשחיתנו; Rashi s.v. עכשיו שאני הטתי

repairs.find: The man marrying a בתולה is worried that he may find she is not a בתולה, so he cannot focus.
repairs.replace: The man marrying a בתולה is preoccupied with thoughts of the first marital union, the בעילת מצוה (Rashi; others explain he worries he may find she is not a בתולה), so he cannot focus.
repairs.why: The site gives a non-Rashi explanation of the groom's distraction as the only one; Rashi says he is preoccupied with the mitzvah of the first union.
repairs.source: Berakhot 11a (הַאי טְרִיד וְהַאי לָא טְרִיד); Rashi s.v. הכונס את הבתולה פטור: שטרוד במחשבת בעילת מצוה

repairs.find: Remember that the argument between רבי יוסי and רבי יהודה is only about after the fact. Both agree that in the first place you should hear what you are saying.
repairs.replace: The גמרא has not yet settled what רבי יהודה holds. Here it tests the idea that he allows it only after the fact, but in step 10 it says he allows it even from the start. רבי יוסי says it does not count even after the fact.
repairs.why: The alert says both agree hearing is required from the start, but this same amud (step 10, and 15a step 25) says רבי יהודה allows it even לכתחילה, so the alert states as settled what the גמרא goes on to reject.
repairs.source: Berakhot 15b: לְעוֹלָם רַבִּי יְהוּדָה הִיא, וַאֲפִילּוּ לְכַתְּחִלָּה נָמֵי; 15a: דְּאִי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה, אֲפִילּוּ לְכַתְּחִלָּה נָמֵי יָצָא

repairs.find: the lenient one is the תנא קמא, who says it counts
repairs.replace: the lenient one is רבי יהודה, who says it counts
repairs.why: The גמרא names the lenient view on hearing as רבי יהודה's, and Rashi says שניהם means רבי יהודה and רבי יוסי.
repairs.source: Berakhot 15a: יָצָא, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי יְהוּדָה; Rashi 15b s.v. הלכה כדברי שניהם להקל: הלכה כר' יהודה דלא בעי שמיעה והלכה כר' יוסי דלא בעי דקדוק

repairs.find: (like the תנא קמא)
repairs.replace: (like רבי יהודה)
repairs.why: Same fix: the lenient view on hearing is רבי יהודה's, as the גמרא and Rashi say.
repairs.source: Rashi 15b s.v. הלכה כדברי שניהם להקל: הלכה כר' יהודה דלא בעי שמיעה

repairs.find: 'Both of them' does not mean two people agree. It means two separate disputes, and in each one we pick the lenient side.
repairs.replace: 'Both of them' means רבי יהודה and רבי יוסי. They argue in two disputes, and in each one we follow whichever of them is lenient: רבי יהודה on hearing, רבי יוסי on the letters.
repairs.why: שניהם refers to the two תנאים (רבי יהודה and רבי יוסי), not to 'two disputes'. Rashi says so explicitly.
repairs.source: Rashi 15b s.v. הלכה כדברי שניהם להקל: הלכה כר' יהודה ... והלכה כר' יוסי

repairs.find: and the גמרא will later discuss what 'therefore' refers to.
repairs.replace: and the גמרא on the next amud shows that this matches a ברייתא about a כהן who takes the money and gives it back.
repairs.why: The גמרא never asks what 'לפיכך' refers to; on 51b it only notes that this line teaches the ברייתא of נטלו והחזירו לו.
repairs.source: Bekhorot 51b: לְפִיכָךְ אִם רָצָה הַכֹּהֵן... תְּנֵינָא לְהָא דְּתָנוּ רַבָּנַן... נְטָלוֹ וְהֶחְזִירוֹ לוֹ — יָצָא

repairs.find: The גמרא will later ask what 'therefore' is connected to.
repairs.replace: On the next amud the גמרא shows this matches a ברייתא: a כהן who takes the money and gives it back.
repairs.why: Same error as in deeperAnalysis: no such question about 'לפיכך' appears in the גמרא.
repairs.source: Bekhorot 51b: תְּנֵינָא לְהָא דְּתָנוּ רַבָּנַן... נְטָלוֹ וְהֶחְזִירוֹ לוֹ — יָצָא

repairs.find: come right after "עשר תעשר"
repairs.replace: come at the end of the same פסוק as "עשר תעשר"
repairs.why: In the פסוק, 'שנה שנה' is at the end of the verse, not directly after 'עשר תעשר'.
repairs.source: Devarim 14:22: עַשֵּׂר תְּעַשֵּׂר אֵת כׇּל תְּבוּאַת זַרְעֶךָ הַיֹּצֵא הַשָּׂדֶה שָׁנָה שָׁנָה

repairs.find: if the calf is not אתנן, the זונה should be able to tithe it herself
repairs.replace: if an animal given while still a fetus is not exempt as a gift, the זונה should be able to tithe it herself
repairs.why: Per Rashi the challenge is that a fetus given to her is not exempted from tithe as a gift; the animal is still אתנן (if it comes out tenth it is eaten with a blemish), and the next steps depend on it being real אתנן.
repairs.source: Bekhorot 56b וְתִיעַשְּׂרֵהּ אִיהִי; Rashi s.v. ותיעשריה איהי: כיון דבמעי אמו נתנו לה לא מיפסיל משום נתן במתנה ויאכל במומו אם יצא האתנן בעשירי

repairs.find: If the unborn calf was never אתנן, why
repairs.replace: If an animal given while still a fetus is not exempt from tithe as a gift, why
repairs.why: Same error: Rashi says the point is that the gift-in-the-womb does not exempt it, not that it was never אתנן.
repairs.source: Rashi s.v. ותיעשריה איהי (Bekhorot 56b)

repairs.find: so it never got the status of אתנן. If so, the calf is a normal animal that belongs to the זונה.
repairs.replace: so it is not exempted as an animal she received as a gift. If so, the calf belongs to the זונה and is subject to tithing in her hands.
repairs.why: Same error: the animal is still אתנן per Rashi (eaten with a blemish if it comes out tenth); only the gift exemption is avoided. Saying it was never אתנן also undercuts step 4, which needs the case to be real אתנן.
repairs.source: Rashi s.v. ותיעשריה איהי (Bekhorot 56b): לא מיפסיל משום נתן במתנה ויאכל במומו אם יצא האתנן בעשירי

repairs.find: The reason the יַרְדֵּן divides is that
repairs.replace: According to רבי אמי, the reason the יַרְדֵּן divides is that
repairs.why: This is only the inference from רבי אמי's bridge rule (אלמא), which the Gemara then drops with אלא in favor of רבי יוחנן's verse-based reason; stating it as the bare ruling is misleading.
repairs.source: Bekhorot 55a אַלְמָא, מִשּׁוּם דְּלָא מְיקָרְבָן הוּא ... אֶלָּא אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא

repairs.find: a זר is not allowed to touch
repairs.replace: a זר is not allowed to eat
repairs.why: A זר is forbidden to eat תרומה and קדשים, not to touch them; the Gemara's point is only that he cannot eat with the כהן.
repairs.source: Arakhin 4a: אִי בָּעֵי זָר לְמֵיכַל בַּהֲדֵי כֹּהֵן לָא מָצֵי אָכֵיל
